title: HardSMP
description:
Hardcore survival.
Build, raid, dominate.
One world. No mercy. Welcome to HardSMP.
body: HardSMP is a brutal survival experience built for players who want real challenge, intense PvP, and a competitive economy. Form alliances, raid enemies, build unstoppable bases, and dominate the world where every decision matters. No hand-holding — only the strongest survive.
